placement: Raised connected rock: cell_center-(24,45), 48x66 canvas. One-cell occupancy unchanged.
height_change: 24px front vs prior 12px. Foot unchanged at center+18. Whole elevated top is 12px higher. Do not use former anchor24,33.
shadow: No cast shadow baked. Intrinsic face shade remains.
connection_update: Re-evaluate cardinals and diagonals in 3x3 after each mined cell. Variant fixed by cell seed, not frame or damage.
damage: 3 static overlays; clip to normal alpha. State thresholds belong to existing game. duration null = hold.
multi_cell: Cluster of independent one-cell nodes, never a single multi-cell resource.
